recommended_formatted_reference: Sledzieski S, Hanson SM. PLANET-MD: Ultra-fast Proteome-scale Prediction of Allosteric Networks in Proteins. bioRxiv [Preprint]. 2026;2025.06.12.659353 (version 2). doi:10.1101/2025.06.12.659353.
related_work_supported_claim: PLANET-MD uses sequence and optional structure representations to predict RMSF, generalized dynamical correlations (GCC-LMI), and structural heterogeneity profiles (SHP). SHP is not this manuscript's joint discrete chi-angle state entropy.
